independent_oracle: Check count and both link directions after every admitted trace of up to7 operations over four items. Test empty/singleton/head/tail/middle removal and checked-sum overflow. Retain removed objects live so rejection tests do not use ended storage. A separate diagnostic/assembly report must distinguish standard initial-member conversion from compiler-supported arbitrary-offset recovery.
